correctness.rationale: Apolar annihilator is the (2,2,d) regular sequence, whose top-degree dual is the displayed form. Hilbert-Burch gives a saturated radical d+3-point apolar ideal. The lower-bound separator lemma forces d collinear points in any shorter set; conic-pencil factorization and h_d nonvanishing at its reduced base support then contradict reducedness of U or V. Algebraic identities were independently tested at six integer d values; uniform proof does not rely on interpolation.
